thread:
Maria P: Quick retrospective on the SI co-sell handoff for CloudMarketplace + hardware partner last week. Noticed a few shadow ownerships and routing hops that caused duplicate outreaches.
Ajay R: Saw that too — two partners got contacted by both the SI and Field on Tue. Confusing for partner.
Sophie L: I can pull the intake sequence logs and the account map. Suggest adding an explicit 'primary_owner' field in intake so handoffs are deterministic.
Tom K: Uploaded a working sheet: https://tiny.redwood/si-handoff-q3 (view only) — check the "ownership" tab.
Maria P: Thanks Tom. Sophie, can you paste the sequence logs where duplicates happened? helps pinpoint the race.
Sophie L: Pasting a short excerpt of webhook audit: 
```
2026-02-15T13:02:11Z SI-intake POST /claims -> assigned region=EMEA owner=field_eu
2026-02-15T13:02:15Z SI-intake POST /claims -> assigned owner=partner_team
```
Looks like two workers handled the claim before sync finished.
Ajay R: Proposal: debounce intake and use deterministic tie-breaker: first-claim wins; subsequent claims are flagged and blocked for 24h unless manual override.
Maria P: Draft RoE bullets (brainstorm):
- First-claim wins on intake.
- SI may request ownership via #partnerships-review within 48h (explicit justification).
- Field asserts regional ownership only if account_map specifies regional cust owner.
- Auto-notifications to both parties on any ownership change.
Sophie L: Add escalation: if duplicate claims exist, partner-engagement lead is auto-notified after 12h.
Tom K: I'll wire a nightly sync job to reconcile account_map -> intake and remove dupe claims (cron: 02:00 UTC). Will add a test mode.
Partners Bot: Reminder: marketplace joint-announcement window closes 2026-03-01 — confirm co-sell owners before then.
Maria P: Concrete action items: 
- @Sophie L: run full log audit + PR for intake debounce (due 2026-02-20)
- @Tom K: update account_map sync + add webhook idempotency fix (due 2026-02-22)
- @Ajay R: draft full Rules of Engagement doc and post to Confluence (due 2026-02-24)
Anyone else want to add items?
Ajay R: I'll take the RoE, will loop in Legal for partner language.
Sophie L: Starting the audit now, will post findings in this thread by EOD Fri.
Tom K: Working on the script tonight; will push a branch and tag @Sophie L for testing.
Maria P: Great — I'll schedule a 30m sync Tue to sign off. :calendar: Thanks all :thumbsup:
